plan.trigger: Only if Nifty trades above R1 25958
plan.stop: Exit if Nifty falls below Pivot 25652

backtest.note: Technical rules only (no historical option-chain data)

playbook.headline: Leaning bullish. Watch R1 25,958: the call plan starts above it.

watch.name: R2
watch.why: Call target and strong resistance. Book profits on calls here.

watch.name: Call-OI wall
watch.why: Most call writers sit here. It tends to cap rallies; a clean break can trigger a fast short-covering move.

watch.name: R1
watch.why: Call trigger. A 15-minute close above this starts the CE plan.

watch.name: Last session high
watch.why: A break above often brings follow-through buying.

watch.name: Pivot
watch.why: Stop-loss line for both plans. Above it buyers control the day, below it sellers do.

watch.name: Max pain
watch.why: Where option buyers lose the most at expiry (23-Nov-2026). Nifty often drifts toward it close to expiry.

watch.name: S1
watch.why: First support. Dips often find buyers here.

watch.name: Last session low
watch.why: A break below often brings follow-through selling.

watch.name: S2
watch.why: Put target and strong support. Book profits on puts here.

watch.name: Put-OI wall
watch.why: Most put writers sit here. It tends to hold dips; a break can speed up a fall.

watch.name: 200-day average
watch.why: Long-term trend line that large funds watch.

watch.name: 50-day average
watch.why: Medium-term trend line. Closing above or below it shifts the bias.

scenarios.when: Nifty closes a 15-minute candle above R1 25,958
scenarios.then: Buy an ATM call. Target R2 26,115, exit if Nifty falls back below the pivot 25,652.

scenarios.when: Nifty closes a 15-minute candle below S1 25,494
scenarios.then: Buy an ATM put. Target S2 25,188, exit if Nifty climbs back above the pivot 25,652. This goes against today's bias, so trade smaller or skip it.

scenarios.when: Nifty stays between S1 25,494 and R1 25,958
scenarios.then: Don't buy options. Premiums lose value every hour in a sideways market.

scenarios.when: Nifty opens more than 129 points (0.5%) away from 25,801
scenarios.then: Wait 15 to 30 minutes. Big gaps often partly fill. Enter only if price holds beyond the first 15-minute high (gap up) or low (gap down).
Premiums decay very fast after noon. Avoid holding bought options into the last two hours.

alerts.title: Broke above the 20-day high of 25,514
alerts.detail: Holding above 25,514 keeps the breakout alive, with R2 26,115 next. Falling back below it would make this a false breakout.

alerts.title: Gap down of 146 points at the open
alerts.detail: The gap zone is 25,368 to 25,514. It has already been filled.
